feedback: just checked the counter and it works

I used the same circuit I used when I simulated the design with an FPGA dev board (BASYS3). I used an oscilloscope to see the square waves of syncRectifierLs and syncRectifierHs outputs. Then I made sure that the duty cycle of both square waves would adjust proportionally as I increased the ADC voltage from 0V to 3.3V. 
My design worked flawlessly. Actually, I'm shocked that it worked, let alone worked exactly how I was hoping it would given that my typical experience with PCB designs is that they usually don't work properly or at all the first time.
